lines.en: Oh, my God! You still have the chipper!
That's what we used to call your, uh,
You know what? A motorcycle is a chopper.
So, you still in touch with anyone from high school?
And, um, I think that's it.

You know, and I see Spindler a lot and Levine, Kelly.

Not so good. Me and Simmons gave him a wedgie.
